propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL is superseded by per-class configuration slots (FRONTIER, REASONER, EVALUATOR) and must be deprecated with a migration window to remove at v1.0.0
the deprecation must be registered in _deprecations.REGISTRY via _scheduled() with permanent=False, emitting warnings via warn_deprecated at every env read site
a single REBAR_LLM_MODEL value must map to all three classes as a fallback default, only when no explicit per-class configuration exists
deprecation warnings must be emitted at two separate env-read sites (config.py:469 for config.from_env() path and model_classes.py for direct slot loading) to cover all code paths
operator-facing documentation including README, config examples, CLI help text, and MCP tool descriptions must redirect from REBAR_LLM_MODEL to per-class configuration syntax

tests must verify the deprecation warning fires exactly once per load_class_slots() call, fires only when the variable is actually set in the environment, fires even when CLI flags override it, and does not fire for config-table model keys
